method.algorithm: Deterministic application of second-round human review over the previous constrained-EM release
method.score_policy: Previous-run scores are historical evidence only and are explicitly marked stale or unavailable after review edits
method.boundary_policy: Apply approved human-review dispositions and require zero final Others assignments
method.l1_routing_policy: Apply explicit human-review routing decisions and preserve the reviewed hierarchy
method.definition_policy: Each bilingual L4 definition explicitly names an AI technology and is reviewed against an immutable L3 drafting anchor
method.title_policy: Formulaic AI involvement modifiers are removed; technical-object AI terms are retained and authoritative terminology families are audited
method.semantic_deduplication_policy: Ten user-approved consolidation clusters were applied after two independent specialist reviews; 13 non-representative cards were retired while preserving source lineage

human_review.score_warning: No EM, Hybrid EM, margin, stability, or candidate score is exposed on public risk cards
human_review.application_policy: Only after an explicit user instruction to analyse and apply review logs
